	<meta property="og:description" content="Why Avalon Academy Bridging Education and Opportunity Our programs are designed to bridge the gap between classroom learning and industry demands,  Read More ensuring that you step into the professional world with full confidence and practical knowledge. Industry-Aligned Curriculum with Global Standards Our internationally acclaimed curriculum is designed in collaboration with industry experts.  Read More This ensures our students receive training that is relevant and recognized across aviation and hospitality sectors worldwide. Industry-Experienced Trainers At Avalon Academy, you learn from the best! Our faculty comprises experienced professionals  Read More from the aviation, hospitality, and retail industries who bring real-world insights into the classrooms. Top-Tier Placement Assistance Our dedicated placement cell provides extensive career guidance, interview preparation, and placement  Read More opportunities with leading airlines, luxury hotels, travel agencies, and high-end retail brands. Networking Edge We help students build valuable connections by providing them access to a vast network of industry  Read More professionals, alumni, and potential employers through industry visits, guest lectures, workshops, and networking events. Profesional Training set-up Our state-of-the-art training facilities replicate real-world work environments, including airport counters,  Read More hospitality settings, and airline cabin crew simulators. Such experience helps students gain confidence and practical skills required in their respective fields. Professional Grooming & Etiquette Our specialized training and grooming sessions ensure that students develop  Read More the right personality, confidence, and soft skills that leave a lasting impression in any professional setting. Internship Experience We provide internship opportunities with leading airlines, hotels, and travel companies, allowing students  Read More to gain valuable industry exposure, apply their knowledge, and enhance their employability skills even before their course completion. Embark on a Journey Above the Clouds. Join Us Today to excel in your professional endeavours. The hospitality, aviation, and retail industries are waiting for skilled professionals like you. Student Enquiry form Avalon Academy is a brand of Aptech offering vocational programs for careers in aviation, hospitality, travel & tourism and retail sectors. Through our wide network of centres across India, we have successfully trained more than thousands of students for domestic and global careers in these growing and dynamic industries.  At Avalon Academy, we do not just train you—we transform you!  Whether you aspire to become a cabin crew, manager of a luxury hotel, or curator of retail experiences, Avalon Academy equips you with the skills to soar.  Our Story We provide holistic guidance and help you transform yourself into successful professionals. We provide an ideal blend of Industry alliances, Cutting-edge infrastructure, Modern-day teaching methodologies, and Seasoned mentors, which ensures you emerge as confident, job-ready professionals ready to leave impeccable footprints in the aviation, hospitality, tourism, and retail sectors.   Join us and grab your boarding pass to explore the world!  avalon academy Our Programs avalon academy Our Programs Aviation We offer industry-aligned courses in aviation, which are accessible to all. Designed by industry experts, our comprehensive training programs equip you with the skills needed for roles such as cabin crew, ground staff, customer service agents, in-flight service personnel, security officers, and cargo and transportation specialists. Hospitality Hospitality Our hospitality courses are designed to impart knowledge and skills pertinent to the hospitality industry, including guest relations, F&B services, front office operations, and event management. Along with technical skills, you will also be trained in communication & presentation skills that will give you a competitive edge over your peers. Luxury Retail LUXURY RETAIL This is one of the most sought-after training programs in recent times designed to introduce you to the fundamentals of retail management, focusing on luxury segment. Courses under this program delves deeper into retail operations, merchandising, and customer service excellence in the luxury market. On completing a course, you can explore careers in duty-free shops and high-end luxury brands. student TESTIMONIALS Our students shine bright and make us proud. Here is a glimpse of some of the success stories that set an example of our dedication to train and groom aspiring young minds.   Tanishka Bakshi IndiGo – Senior Cabin Crew “I am incredibly thankful to Aptech Aviation for shaping my career and giving me the foundation to become a Senior Cabin Crew with IndiGo Airlines. The training was comprehensive and practical, and the support from the trainers was outstanding. It gave me the confidence to pursue my passion for aviation and excel in my role. Aptech Aviation has been a key part of my journey, and I highly recommend it to anyone who dreams of a career in aviation.” Deeti Zala Air India Express – Cabin Crew “I am extremely grateful to Aptech Aviation for helping me kick-start my career as a Cabin Crew with Air India Express. The training was top-notch, and the practical skills I gained gave me the confidence to excel in the aviation industry. The supportive trainers and the hands-on experience provided me with everything I needed to succeed. I highly recommend Aptech Aviation to anyone aspiring to be part of the aviation world. It was an amazing journey, and I’m proud to be a part of Air India Express today.” CAREER PATHS avalon academy Avalon Academy has a dedicated Placement Assistance team that helps you to land your dream career in the aviation industry after successfully completing your course. The team in accordance with the faculty conducts mock interview sessions that help you appear for final interviews.   Leading brands from the luxury retail, aviation and hospitality sectors come to Avalon Academy centres for on-campus interviews. Some of the most sought after career paths in these sectors are: Know more PLACEMENT PARTNERS Our Placement Team provides complete assistance to our students to find suitable job opportunities as per their course, skills, talents, and interests. We have tied up with national and international companies in the field of aviation, hospitality, travel & tourism, retail and event management to ensure that you receive the best career opportunities after completing your chosen course. We have helped companies find candidates for various job roles in the sector of aviation, hospitality and retail sectors. Some of our top placement partners are:  RBL" />

	<meta property="og:description" content="Home > Page ABOUT AVALON ACADEMY Avalon Academy is a leading vocational training institute that provides skill-based training in aviation, hospitality, and luxury retail sectors. With a strong emphasis on professionalism and excellence, the academy offers structured programs tailored to prepare students for successful careers as cabin crew, ground staff, F&B Managers, Ticketing Supervisors, Front Office Executives and more. All-inclusive Curriculum: The programs encompass all facets of the aviation, hospitality, and luxury retail industries, ensuring students receive a well-rounded education. Certified Faculty: Leveraging in-depth industry insights, the faculty brings a wealth of knowledge and practical experience to students. National Presence: Avalon Academy has established centres across India, making quality aviation training accessible to a broad spectrum of students, including freshers and professionals.  By integrating rigorous training methodologies with industry-relevant knowledge, Avalon Academy equips students with the skills needed to excel in the fields of aviation, hospitality, and luxury retail. Student Enquiry form aBOUT APTECH Aptech is a pioneer in vocational education and skill development training. Having commenced its operations in 1986, today, Aptech operates through a network of centres across 40 countries and five continents. It offers a diverse range of career courses in fields such as animation, VFX, gaming, beauty and wellness, aviation and hospitality and banking and IT programs. Aptech’s programs and course materials are designed after conducting extensive research on global industry trends. Certified faculty members ensure that students have access to comprehensive courseware and learn with the modern teaching tools and methods. With a commitment to quality education and skill development, Aptech continues to empower students worldwide, preparing them for successful careers in various industries. WHY CHOOSE US Choosing the right institution plays a crucial role for a successful career. Avalon Academy stands out as a premier choice for students who wants to make a successful career in aviation, tourism, luxury retail, and hospitality industries. Here’s why: Experienced Faculty You will benefit from knowledgeable mentors who come with relevant industry experience and are able to deliver modern-day programs while keeping you updated with the latest industry trends.   Experienced Faculty You will benefit from knowledgeable mentors who come with relevant industry experience and are able to deliver modern-day programs while keeping you updated with the latest industry trends.   Comprehensive Program Curriculum We offer a diverse range of courses, including cabin crew, ground staff, customer care support, and personality development. These programs equip you with the necessary skills to excel in the aviation, hospitality, and luxury retail industries.   Placement Assistance Our dedicated placement cell offers complete placement assistance to deserving students and helps them secure jobs with leading aviation, hospitality, and retail brands.    Award-winning Aviation Training Institute An established aviation training institution that is consistently earning accolades for its commitment to educational excellence. The recognitions are a testament to its commitment to delivering quality education and training in the aviation, hospitality, and luxury retail industries. Our PROGRAMS Aviation We offer career-building courses that prepare you for the ever-booming world of aviation. Our courses combine classroom learning and practical sessions, which makes you job-ready by the end of the course. Hospitality A complete industry-oriented program that trains you in all aspects of hospitality, starting from guest services and accounting to housekeeping, front office and F&B management. Luxury Retail An exciting program that combines practical learning with classroom lessons. You will learn various aspects of luxury retail operations such as setting up a luxury retail store, handling high-end customers, and brand management. Wish to make your career future-proof in the aviation, hospitality, or luxury retail industries? Enquire Now Awards AND ACHIEVEMENTS Over the years, Aptech has received lots of prestigious awards at national and international levels for its contribution to the vocational and skill-training sectors. Aptech won the ‘Skill Development Company of the Year Award’ under the category of Leadership in Education at the Business Innovation Conference & Awards in the year 2022. Aptech won the ‘’Golden Peacock National Training Award’’ at the Dubai Global Convention in the year 2023. Aptech was conferred the Golden Peacock National Training Award 2024 at the 2024 UAE Global Convention & 31st Annual World Congress on Leadership for Innovation & Business Excellence. Partner WITH US Avalon Academy is constantly looking for business partners who can open centres in their preferred locations.  The company has a proven partnership model, with both the company and the business partners supporting each other in achieving business goals.  There is a growing demand for vocational courses and skill-based training programs in industries like aviation, travel, retail, and hospitality. So, invest in the education industry and reap high returns with minimum investment.  To set up your own Avalon Academy centre, Fill the form Wish to make a promising career in the  Aviation, Hospitality, and Luxury Retail Sectors?
